about_the_game:
🎾 Super Tennis Breakout – Demo Edition

Experience a first taste of Super Tennis Breakout, a retro-fueled arcade fusion where tennis meets brick-breaking physics. This early demo focuses on the intense Beat The Wall mode, giving you a short but punchy glimpse of what’s coming.

🧱 What’s Inside:

  • 5 handcrafted Beat The Wall levels

  • 3 thumping retro synth tracks

  • 5 unique Cube Types, each with its own behaviour

  • 3 satisfying power-ups to turn the tide

  • Responsive Dash mechanic for precise, kinetic control

  • Full physics-based gameplay: every hit feels dynamic and destructive

💥 Expect around 10 minutes of total action-packed play perfect for chasing high scores, learning the bounce patterns, and getting hooked on the chaos. It’s easy to jump in, but hard to walk away.

👾 This is just the beginning. The full game will bring multiple game modes, expanded systems, local co-op & versus play, enemy encounters, leaderboards, and much more arcade madness down the line.

Still shaping this game—your feedback is fuel. Let me know what you think!
